cv.name: Hannah Bui
cv.headline: Production Manager | Plastics & Food Manufacturing | Lean
cv.summary: Production leader with seven years in food and plastics manufacturing. Returned to work in 2025 after a two-year career break caring for a family member, and completed a Lean refresher before taking on my current role.

experience.title: Production Manager
bullets: Run three shifts and 48 operators across injection moulding and assembly
Introduced daily tiered meetings and visual boards on the shop floor
Reduced scrap on the main line from 4.1% to 2.6% in the first nine months
Work with maintenance on a preventive schedule for 22 presses

experience.title: Production Supervisor
bullets: Supervised a ready-meals line of 25 staff under HACCP and BRC requirements
Led a changeover reduction project that saved 40 minutes per shift

experience.title: Graduate Process Engineer
bullets: Collected OEE data and supported line trials for new packaging formats

extra_sections: Career break 2022 – 2024: full-time carer for a family member
